# AgentBio AI - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: AgentBio AI
- Tagline: An agent bio that builds trust in 60 seconds.
- Domain: https://agentbio-ai.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- From your market, years, and wins, generate a first-person bio for your site, Zillow, or About page - confident, not cheesy.
- First-person voice
- Market positioning
- Wins without bragging
- Site / Zillow ready

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — 3 bios/mo
- **Pro** — $15/mo — Unlimited, save history
- Checkout: https://agentbio-ai.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://agentbio-ai.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. What is AgentBio AI?
A1. From your market, years, and wins, generate a first-person bio for your site,
Q2. Do I need an API key?
A2. No. The platform key runs the engine; Enterprise offers BYOK.
Q3. How is my data used?
A3. Only to produce your your agent. We do not train public models on it without consent.
Q4. Can I export the result?
A4. Yes — JSON download and clipboard on every plan.
